description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: Add a focused Channels file retrieval API module, with domain event/API wiring, that resolves a delivered attachment reference for a trusted session-derived actor. Reuse Engine canonical message/conversation authorization to bind the attachment to the requested message and connector, then refresh current source access and retrieve disk/Drive content. Reuse Record provenance, TrustedContext, data-source APIs and materialization. Persist only durable descriptors sufficient for authorized history resolution; never expose bearer materialization handles to browsers. Final module name follows live responsibility discovery.

Tests to add before implementation: Real session-actor/Engine/Channels integration for source ACL denial, revoked grants, nonexistent or forged attachment/message/config references, nil actor, disk and Drive retrieval; filename/MIME and exact content assertions. Denials precede provider I/O.

Branches/paths validated: Authorized current download; cross-user/conversation/config access; changed source ACL; disabled source; missing file; provider failure; history reload.

Mocking plan: External Drive HTTP only; real disk fixtures, authorization, NodeRouter and canonical persistence. No global state changes.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content: docs/services/channels.md, materialization.md and web-bridge.md; public API ownership and errors.

Action reuse assessment: Extend existing domain retrieval and canonical-read operations. DownloadDocument/materialization alone cannot authorize a browser request: handles are bearer locators and redemption does not recheck source ACL. Shared domain orchestration stays local-only because session/delivery binding is a transport access boundary, not an agent tool. Inputs are trusted actor plus delivered-message attachment identity; outputs content/filename/MIME or denial/not-found/provider error. No upload or publication side effects; repeated authorized GET is read-only.

Implementation handoff: Scope and sequence approved by the user on 2026-11-28. This turn records the plan only; application implementation, commits, pushes, rebases and dependency publication are not performed or authorized by this planning update. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md before execution. Read applicable service guides and module responsibilities; Agent work requires the harness-critical checks; BO work requires DESIGN.md and docs/bo-components.md. Recheck live source and dependency contracts. Preserve existing test behavior unless specifically approved. Write immediate unit/integration/property tests before corresponding code; new browser journeys wait for the human UX gate. Keep real internal boundaries, mock only external edges, and inject runtime dependencies through existing opts/context and Zaq.Config. Follow the owning validation lifecycle. PR7 owns RunAgent, NotifyPerson and notification/workflow integration.
title: [zaq-pi3.12] Add authorized retrieval for delivered source attachments
